explanation: Using the continuity theorem specified in this lesson, I fails because ∂|x-t|/∂t is undefined at x=t. II has continuous partial derivative (1+x²-t²)/(1+x²+t²)², and III has continuous partial derivative -3/(x+t+1)⁴ throughout its stated domain. Thus II and III satisfy the lesson's conditions. Under a weaker almost-everywhere differentiation theorem, I can also be differentiated under the integral; it does not satisfy the criterion taught here.
